payload.title: De-duplication agent with a generated context pack, reversible grouping relations
payload.description: Candidates come from code: identity keys, title similarity (`ideas/dedupe.py` scorer), `related_to` edges by score, nearest neighbours from summary vectors. A generated context pack per candidate group gives the agent each item's title, host, date, summary and first text, plus nearby items. The agent answers per group: same document, same story, related, or different, with a reason and quotes; code verifies quotes (fact-check/v1 rules). Stored as reversible relations `same_document_as` and `same_story_as`. No fixed thresholds where a learned cut can be used (`duplicate_cut`, Wilson bound), adaptive per site. Runs after suggestions in the hourly pass, or nightly, bounded by real time and spend. Also fix URL-only titles, which hide most same-story coverage.
